namespacemanager-desc: Create and manage custom namespaces directly from your wiki
managenamespaces-intro: Add, edit, or remove custom namespaces. Changes apply to subsequent requests.
namespacemanager-javascript-required: JavaScript is required to manage namespaces.
namespacemanager-load-error: The namespaces could not be loaded.
namespacemanager-empty: No custom namespaces have been configured.
namespacemanager-save-error: The namespace configuration could not be saved. Correct the highlighted fields and try again.
namespacemanager-id-help: Enter an unused even number from 3000 through 4998. The following odd number is reserved for the talk namespace.
namespacemanager-name-help: Enter the canonical subject namespace name. Spaces are converted to underscores, and colons are not allowed.
namespacemanager-talkname-help: Leave blank to use the namespace name followed by “_talk”.
namespacemanager-aliases-help: Enter alternative names for the subject namespace. Press Enter after each alias.
namespacemanager-chip-description: Press Enter to add an item. Press Backspace to remove the selected item.
namespacemanager-talkaliases-help: Enter alternative names for the talk namespace. Press Enter after each alias.
namespacemanager-editpermissions-help: Enter MediaWiki rights that a user must have to modify pages in the subject namespace. Press Enter after each right.
namespacemanager-talkeditpermissions-hel: Enter MediaWiki rights that a user must have to modify pages in the talk namespace. Press Enter after each right.
namespacemanager-error-invalid-id: Use an unused even ID from 3000 through 4998.
namespacemanager-error-invalid-name: Enter a non-empty name without a colon.
namespacemanager-error-duplicate-id: This ID conflicts with another namespace or talk namespace.
namespacemanager-error-duplicate-name: This name or alias conflicts with another namespace.
namespacemanager-error-name-too-long: Use a name no longer than 255 bytes.
namespacemanager-error-field: This field contains an invalid value.
apihelp-namespacemanager-summary: Reads or atomically replaces NamespaceManager definitions.
apihelp-namespacemanager-param-operation: Whether to get or save definitions.
apihelp-namespacemanager-param-namespace: A JSON array of namespace definitions for a save operation.
apierror-namespacemanager-invalid-json: The namespaces parameter is not valid JSON.
apierror-namespacemanager-missing-namesp: The namespaces parameter is required for save operations.
apierror-namespacemanager-validation: One or more namespace definitions are invalid.
